# Contributing

Keep one reviewable topic per PR. Discuss substantial feature direction in an
issue before implementation. Explain the problem, resulting behavior and relevant
tradeoff; report commands, results and anything you could not verify.

Use `Closes #123` or `Fixes #123` when a PR completes an issue. For partial work,
use `Related to #123` and state what remains. Completed issues close on merge.
There is no release-confirmation or inactivity-close bot.

Write commit messages and PR descriptions in English. Add the project's build,
test commands, license for contributions and relevant local conventions here.
